title: 12/21/18 - Software Updates | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: 12/21/18 - Software Updates Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000052761 We made updates to several Default Widgets this week. If you have customized any of these widgets and would like to update your customized widget, you can find the latest code in the corresponding Default Widget. Please remember that if you have a custom version of any of these widgets, our latest updates have not been pushed to your website. Updates: We added a "Continue" button on the Profile Photo tab in the Member Dashboard area. Widgets Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Account - Profile Image Upload We improved the the search feature for Coupons Codes in the Admin Area so the search applies to the Inactive tab as well. We updated the Newest Members widget to sort by Signup Date instead of User ID. Widgets Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Display - Recent Members We updated the Member Search Results H1 title in order to show the correct information based on the search criteria. Widgets Involved: Search - Member - Search Query We improved the accuracy of the location search on the Member Search page in the Admin area. We updated the Menu Manager to support default menus (like the Widget Manager and Forms Manager). We fixed an issue which was affecting the Mobile Layout of sites when the Website Announcement Bar is activated. We improved the the accuracy of member location searched on the frontend of sites. Widgets Involved: Search - Member - Search Query Bootstrap Theme - Homepage Search - Clickable USA Map We fixed an issue which was affecting the default behavior of the Claimable Business Listing Add-On. Widgets Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Forms - Claim Listing Blurb We updated the Recaptcha Header Message button in the Admin Panel in order to redirect to the current support article on the topic. We fixed an issue which was affecting the UI of the Recent and Featured Member widgets. Widgets Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Display - Homepage Featured Members Bootstrap Theme - Display - Recent Members We fixed an issue that was preventing Admins from adding individual sub categories when the site has thousands of Top Level Categories. We fixed an issue which was causing lead invoices to not be marked as paid after a payment was made in the 2Checkout payment gateway. Widgets Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Account - Notifications Controller We fixed an issue which was preventing members from adding some zipcodes as additional locations. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Account - Select Locations We fixed an issue that was still showing the About Title on profile pages when the "Enable About Tab Product" setting is set to "No". Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Member Profile - Overview Tab We added the ability to display Sub Category Images in the keyword Autosuggest Feature. We fixed an issue which was affecting the ability to Add and Delete Sub Level Category Images on the Category Page in the Admin in some cases. We fixed an issue which was causing Google Recaptcha to not work properly on Signup pages in some cases. We updated the "Google Map Search Results" Add-On to include the additional listings on the map when the "Load More" button is clicked on search results pages using the "Insta-Load Search Results" Add-On. Widgets Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Search Results Map We fixed an issue which was affecting the default behavior of the Live Design tool. We fixed an issue that was causing a "Save 100%" message to display on member signup pages when "Quarterly" is the only billing cycle option selected for the product. Widgets Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Form - Membership Payment Options The Spam Form Protector Add-On has been released as a Free Add-On for all websites. We added the ability to set a CSS class for a Menu's outer <ul> tag. This new feature will be available for all new Menus. In order to use this feature navigate to Admin >> Toolbox >> Menu Manager >> New Menu. We added the ability to Install an SSL certificate from the Admin Header Message button. We added a setting to display an RSS icon linking to the main RSS feed of a site when the RSS Feed Add-On is active. In order to use this new feature navigate to Admin >> Settings >> General Settings >> Social Media tab. Widgets Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Module - Social Media Links Bootstrap Theme - Social Media Links For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
